name: pushgenius-notify
description: Push a notification to your phone (via PushGenius) when Claude Code finishes a turn or is blocked waiting on you.

app_id.title: PushGenius App ID (optional)
app_id.description: Usually not needed: the REST key is already tied to one app. Fill in only if the API asks for it.

api_key.title: PushGenius REST API key
api_key.description: Dashboard > Settings > REST API key. Stored in your OS keychain, never in settings.json.

user_id.title: Your external_id
user_id.description: The ID you passed to login() on the device that should receive pushes (e.g. 'me').

push_on_stop.title: Push when Claude finishes a turn
push_on_stop.description: Stop hook: one push per completed turn, with the last message as the body.

push_on_error.title: Push when a turn dies on an API error
push_on_error.description: StopFailure hook: rate limits, auth failures, server errors.

push_on_needs_you.title: Push when Claude is blocked on you
push_on_needs_you.description: Permission prompts and agents waiting for input.

push_on_idle.title: Push when Claude has been idle a minute
push_on_idle.description: idle_prompt notification: fires about 60s after a turn ends with no reply. Off by default because it doubles up with the finished push.

push_on_quota.title: Push on usage-limit events
push_on_quota.description: When a task paused by a usage limit resumes, goes stale, or gives up.

push_on_prompt.title: Push on every prompt you type (test only)
push_on_prompt.description: UserPromptSubmit hook. Useful to confirm pushes arrive; very noisy otherwise.

quiet_seconds.title: Quiet period (seconds)
quiet_seconds.description: Suppress a Stop push if one was sent fewer than this many seconds ago. 0 = push on every turn.
